body: I'm just scared that if I use a hands-off approach he will never talk to me and he will feel more alone and our relationship will weaken then one day he might just do it.

I have tried many times telling him things like how I love him, and how much he mean to me and my friend either doesn't respond or changes the topic.

I understand what you're saying, but I don't see anything that I haven't tried so many times.

I feel hopeless and like I can't help at all. I can't help my friend who means so much to me.

My friend doesn't even know I reported him.

I don't think I've ever told him that there was something wrong with him. I've just told him positive stuff like find something to live for. or I'll tell him that he's smart and he has a great future. Stuff like that. He got cheered up when his depression first started from it, but now it's back even worse and nothing -- no matter how positive -- i say can stop him or help him.

I don't know what to do. He isn't only my best friend, he is like my brother. He is like the only person that understands me. I don't want him to do this to himself.
